[[b]]LIU YU REWORK[[/b]]
Adjusted Liu Yu's Northern Courage disable from being given at the start to now being based on his resource (restricted to the last two tiers of his mechanic)
Qiang, Di, Xianbei, and Xiliang characters and regions
Added Yan Rou to the Backbone
PLACEHOLDER
[[b]]Yufuluo[[/b]] gains a unique banditry building option.
UNIQUE BUILDINGS
[[b]]ADDITONS + BUG FIXES[[/b]]
Fixed Gongsun Zan, Yuan Yi, and Yuan Shu not getting their unique skills
All Han, bandit, and Northern Tribes playable factions should have access to missions
Fixed Chen Wen not being able to recruit the new units added by the Southern update
[[b]]Zhang Yang[[/b]] gains a unique forge building option.
CHILDREN IN COURT
Family Tree
[[b]]KOREA & THE NORTHEAST[[/b]]
Goguryeo, Silla, Gaya, Buyeo, Dongye, Baekje and Tamno gain around 59 named historical characters.
Baekje adds sixteen named characters of the Onjo line, with their own name pool.
A hundred Korea-specific generic templates, so Korean factions no longer draw on the Han Chinese pool.
A dedicated Korean technology tree: Court, Military and Economy, five tiers each, 60 techs.
Fifteen skill trees for generic Korean characters and twelve unique trees for named rulers.
A Korean court screen with its own office titles, and a matching faction progression panel.
Korean Frontier Works: five provincial recruitment hubs drawing on the peoples of each province.
Seven dynastic career chains unlocking unique armour and narrative titles.
Twenty-one new birth events for Korean children, plus events for unique characters joining you.
[[b]]NEW MECHANICS[[/b]]
Nomadic Hordes: Wuhuan, Xiongnu and Xianbei develop through their armies instead of settlements.
Governor Edicts: Gongsun Zan's five inspectors each enact a regional edict drawn from their traits.
Ma Teng's Stables: breed, train and break in horses across six frontier bloodlines.
Trial by Combat: Lu Bu duels the Greatest Warriors serving in his own faction.
The Greatest Warriors roster grows from 46 to 88.
The Black Market: You Tu earns Enforcement in battle and spends it on equipment cases.
Around ninety new Faction Council suggestions, generic and faction-flavoured.
The Bandit Council: bandit factions hold their own council each Winter.
The Grand Tournament: a year-long arc with a champion and four seasonal bouts.
The Needle Path: Zhang Jin spends Qi across 32 acupuncture points.
Father's Legacy: a twelve-mission track for Zhu Hao and 24 permanent unit doctrines.
Sanity: Qu Pan's grip on reality drives a seasonal event each Harvest.
Contest of the Northern Captains: seven warlords race up a seven-level mission ladder.
[[b]]NEW UNITS (AUGUST 2026)[[/b]]
Over sixty new units, unlocking at character ranks 3 and 6.
Six Korean polities gain two units each, plus the Arrow Storm war machine for all of Korea.
Sixteen southern warlords gain two units each.
Huang Zu, Cai Mao, Hu Mao and You Tu gain unique units of their own.
New regional-recruitment Korean units, and new banners for the steppe factions.
[[b]]NEW BUILDINGS (AUGUST 2026)[[/b]]
A complete nomadic settlement line across five districts, up to the Royal Encampment.
Chen Kingdom Garrison, Liu Chong's unique military chain.
Ember Shrine, Wu Huan's hidden congregations, up to the Inferno of the Yellow Sky.
Hall of Repose, Wang Sheng's unique building.
New garrison chains for Ma Teng and for the nomadic factions.
[[b]]INTERFACE & QUALITY OF LIFE[[/b]]
The Ironic Menu, a new hub linking Character Births, Character Joins and the Mod Guide.
Character Births lists every scripted historical child and whether they have been born.
Character Joins lists every general who can come over, with their window and status.
The Character Compendium shows birth year, age, service, spouse and effects.
Spy status badges give a counter-espionage read on each character.
Mute a commandery to silence its notification badges, up to eight at a time.
Releasing a character from service now asks for confirmation first.
Horde building costs and Ze Rong raid income appear in the standard hover breakdowns.
Several settings now apply the moment you press Apply, without a reload.
[[b]]BALANCE & TUNING[[/b]]
Wooden Stakes are disabled by default; a setting turns them back on.
Barbarian factions no longer take the rage-based tax modifier.
New starting retinues for Cai Mao, Liu Biao, Huang Zu and You Tu.
Liu Xun, Shi Huang, Zhu Fu and Jiuzhen recruit from their own pools.
Campaign intro loading screens added for fifteen more factions.
Korean name pools expand by 134 clone names and 34 unique names.
Twenty-four bandit and rebel factions move onto the bandit building set.
Tribal buildings open to Korean, Yellow Turban and Nanman cultures.
New difficulty and playstyle ratings on the faction select screen.
You Tu can confederate with bandits; Huang Clan and Zhang Jin can treat with them.
Jiuzhen now holds Faction Council meetings.
Spouse assignment experience is capped so it no longer runs away early.
Ma Teng loses access to the Qiang building chain.
The window to claim a faction tutorial reward grows from 3 turns to 10.
[[b]]FIXES (AUGUST 2026)[[/b]]
Fixed an intermittent crash when a faction died and its characters were absorbed.
Singleplayer characters now receive their scripted starting equipment.
Scripted level-ups work again, so Northern Captains promotions now advance.
Physical trait removal works again.
Ze Rong's raiding income no longer stacks when several armies share a region.
Korean effect bundles can be removed again, and children are no longer skipped.
Faction tutorial chains regain their missing recruit-units step.
A settings opt-out that compared against text rather than true or false now works.
Eighteen placeholder skill and ability entries have real names and descriptions.
Faction feature target markers no longer over-fire for Liu Bei and Liu Yu.
You Tu's faction-select border no longer uses Zhang Jin's artwork.
